profile.name: Andor Neo科学CMOS相机
profile.description: Andor Neo是一款科学级CMOS相机，用于实验室中的低噪声、高灵敏度二维成像。它常用于显微成像、光学检测和需要可调曝光、传感器读出与区域选取的科学图像采集实验。
profile.description_en: The Andor Neo is a scientific CMOS camera for low-noise, high-sensitivity 2D imaging in laboratories. It is commonly used for microscopy, optical measurements, and scientific image acquisition experiments that require adjustable exposure, sensor readout settings, and region-of-interest selection.
